title: FactInput
description: One fact the portal proposes about its client. BigLaw coerces an unknown category to "note" (never rejects it). Caps: value and note ≤ 2000 chars. Tolerant reader: receivers MUST ignore properties they do not know; additionalProperties is therefore never false in this contract.

category.description: Known values: identity, contact, family, financial, employment, matter, adverse_party, goal, concern, constraint, preference, history, note. Unknown values are accepted and stored as "note".
